cases.purpose: Probe which namespace and kernel facilities a mapped user namespace provides to network fixtures.
cases.oracle: Raw capability probe output retained in evidence; carries no behavioral expectation. The raw output goes to probe.out, kept in the recorded case tree; stdout carries only the fixed marker "probe".
cases.candidate_script:
/usr/bin/unshare --user --map-root-user --net --mount --uts "$BASH" --noprofile --norc -c '
export PATH=/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin
echo "== id"; id
echo "== builtins"; for b in ip fw ping ss netstat netids pcap wg; do echo "$b: $(type -t $b)"; done
echo "== link types"
for t in dummy veth wireguard bridge vlan; do
  if [ $t = veth ]; then ip link add p0 type veth peer name p1; else ip link add x$t type $t; fi; echo "$t rc=$?"
done
echo "== iptables"; iptables -V; iptables -A OUTPUT -j DROP; echo "iptables-append rc=$?"; iptables -S
ip6tables -A OUTPUT -j DROP; echo "ip6tables-append rc=$?"
echo "== nft cli"; command -v nft; echo rc=$?
echo "== sysctl ping range"; echo "0 2000" > /proc/sys/net/ipv4/ping_group_range; echo rc=$?; cat /proc/sys/net/ipv4/ping_group_range
echo "== packet sock"; python3 -c "
import socket
s=socket.socket(socket.AF_PACKET,socket.SOCK_RAW,socket.htons(3)); print(\"af_packet ok\")
s=socket.socket(socket.AF_INET,socket.SOCK_RAW,socket.IPPROTO_ICMP); print(\"raw icmp ok\")
s=socket.socket(socket.AF_INET,socket.SOCK_DGRAM,socket.IPPROTO_ICMP); print(\"dgram icmp ok\")
"
echo "== tools"; ls /usr/sbin/tcpdump /usr/bin/ping /usr/bin/traceroute /usr/bin/ss /usr/sbin/ip /usr/bin/ip /usr/bin/wg /usr/sbin/conntrack 2>&1
echo "== tcpdump -D"; tcpdump -D 2>&1 | head
echo "== modules"; head -c 600 /proc/modules; ls /sys/module | tr "\n" " " | head -c 1500; echo
echo "== nf"; ls /proc/net | tr "\n" " "; echo; ls /proc/sys/net/netfilter 2>&1 | head
echo "== ip -V"; ip -V; cat /proc/net/protocols | head -30
echo "== wg genl"; ip link show xwireguard 2>&1
' > probe.out 2>&1
echo probe

cases.purpose: Probe ip builtin and iproute2 output formats in a seeded namespace.
cases.oracle: Raw output retained in evidence; no behavioral expectation. The raw output goes to probe.out, kept in the recorded case tree; stdout carries only the fixed marker "probe".
cases.candidate_script:
/usr/bin/unshare --user --map-root-user --net --mount --uts "$BASH" --noprofile --norc -c '
export PATH=/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin
R=/usr/bin/ip
$R link add d0 type dummy; echo "dummy rc=$?"
$R link add v0 type veth peer name v1; echo "veth rc=$?"
$R link add wg0 type wireguard; echo "wireguard rc=$?"
$R link set d0 mtu 1400 address 02:00:00:00:00:01 up
$R addr add 192.0.2.1/24 dev d0; $R addr add 198.51.100.7/32 dev d0; $R addr add fd00::1/64 dev d0
$R route add 203.0.113.0/24 via 192.0.2.254 dev d0 metric 50
$R route add 10.20.0.0/16 dev d0 table 100
$R rule add from 10.9.0.0/16 table 100 priority 500
$R neigh add 192.0.2.99 lladdr 02:00:00:00:00:99 dev d0 nud permanent
cmp() { echo "######## ip $*"; echo "--- builtin"; ip "$@" 2>&1; echo "rc=$?"; echo "--- iproute2"; $R "$@" 2>&1; echo "rc=$?"; }
cmp link show d0
cmp -br link show
cmp -o link show d0
cmp -j link show d0
cmp addr show
cmp -4 addr show
cmp -6 addr show
cmp addr show d0
cmp addr show to 192.0.2.0/24
cmp addr show scope host
cmp -br addr show
cmp -j addr show d0
cmp route show
cmp route show dev d0
cmp route show table 100
cmp route show table all
cmp -j route show
cmp rule show
cmp -j rule show
cmp neigh show
cmp neigh show dev d0
cmp -j neigh show dev d0
echo "######## builtin vs ping_group_range"
echo "0 0" > /proc/sys/net/ipv4/ping_group_range; echo rc=$?; cat /proc/sys/net/ipv4/ping_group_range
' > probe.out 2>&1
echo probe
